findings.title: Partial close still contaminates persistent acceptance estimates
findings.trigger: Close generator after one accepted output at budget 4 before the correction output. observe_cycle receives budget=4, accepted=1, produced=1.
findings.observed: complete_output_cycle=False excludes cost calibration, but AdaptivePolicy.observe counts positions 1 through 3 as failed acceptance even though those outputs were never emitted.
findings.impact: The policy survives requests, so cancellation/EOS/output truncation can bias later yield and budget decisions. N-2 delay alone does not make the biased evidence valid.
findings.requested_change: Keep actual complete-cycle cost and consumed output diagnostics, but exclude partial-cycle acceptance from future decision statistics or represent observed acceptance positions explicitly. Add an assertion that partial close cannot create false rejections.
